description.value:
Frequency Once per round.

Requirements Blaster has one live Flash Mob Hype Thrall within 60 feet.

Blaster spends 1 action and chooses one such thrall and one benefit for Blaster only: @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-items.Item.BlasterInspire01]{Inspire} (+1 status to attack rolls, damage rolls, and saves against fear), @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-items.Item.BlasterGuard0001]{Guard} (+1 status to AC), or @UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-items.Item.BlasterTempHP001]{Bolster} (10 temporary HP once, never added to existing temporary HP). Each benefit lasts until the start of Blaster's next turn, or until spent for temporary HP.

The selected thrall provides only that benefit; it receives no turn, movement, Strike, spell, or extra actions. This command is available once per round, separately from Flash Mob summoning; paying extra actions does not allow another command that round. Status bonuses of the same type do not stack; temporary HP never stack. The thrall does not need to spend an action of its own.

@UUID[Compendium.astillon-hanaq-adventures-module.astillon-blaster-macros.Macro.BlasterMobCmd001]{Command Flash Mob}. Without the command runtime, pay the action, check the live thrall and 60-foot range, and drag exactly one linked effect onto Blaster during his turn. Remove the previous copy before reapplying that effect. Track expiry manually if encounter time is not advancing.
